book.name: Markos
book.title: Ka Maroyow No Nangnangonon No Insulat Ni Markos Bahin Ki Hisu Kristu

content: Nootawan on si Hisus
Ko katangkob on ka karusiloman to Allow ran to Oghimoloy
nigboli ni Maria no taga Magdala, si Salomi woy si Maria no inoy ni Santiago, ka mgo mohomut no lana no litos to igbus-ug to lawa ni Hisus.
Ko napawo on to Dominggu, nighondio sikandan to pilang no nigsabalan ki Hisus.

Pogligkat dan on, mabatbataroy ran no kagi ran, “Hontow buwa ka ogpaliiron ta to batu no duon to bo-bo to pilang?” Dakol ka sika batu. Nò, ko nigtonggak dan nigkita ran to noonsig ka batu no inlokob to bo-bo to pilang no warad naatangi.
Ko nigsolod sikandan to pilang, nigkita ran ka bato-bato pad no lukos no ogpinpinnuu dio to kawanan dan no maputi ka kinabo din. Noinuinu on sikandan no nigkolkol so goinawa ran.
Kagi to sikan no nigpinnuu, “Ko kow ogkahallok. Ogpamitowan now si Hisus no taga Nasarit no inlansang dan dio to ampow to krus. Warad man dini; nootawan on. Pitowa now ka nohibatan din.
Di hipanow kow on. Nangoni now on si Pedro mgo duma no hibatoon din. Soini ka ignangon now kandan, ‘Oghun-a si Hisus kaniu dio to Galilia. Dio now kitaa sikandin no unawa to innangon din kaniu.’ ”
Nò, niglibuwas to sikan no pilang ka mgo boi no nigpallaguy su noinuinu woy ogkolkol so goinawa ran. Waro dan nangoni ka agad hontow su nahallok lagboy sikandan.
Ka Dangob no Katapusan to Markos16:8 Bahin to birsikulu 9–20, waro to duma no mgo sinulat to Ginirigu. Nigpakita si Hisus ki Maria Magdalina
Nootawan on si Hisus ko solomsolom to Dominggu. Si Maria Magdalina ka an-anayan no otow no nigkita kandin. Soini Maria ka boi no nigdogil ni Hisus ka papitu no busow no nigsolod to lawa rin.
Nighondio sikandin no ognangon to mgo sakup ni Hisus no ogsinsinogow sikandan no masakit lagboy so goinawa ran.
Di ko nigdinog dan to nootawan on si Hisus woy to nigkita ni Maria sikandin, waro tuui sikandin.
Nigpapitow si Hisus to Darua no Sakup din
Waro malugoy no duon darua no sakup din no nighipanow dio to dalan no oghondio to hilit. Poglibuwas ni Hisus kandan, loin ka langlangawan din no wa dan tokora.
Di ko nigtokod dan on, niglibong dio to Hirusalim woy nignangonan dan ka duma no mgo sakup din di waro tuui kandan.
Nigpakita si Hisus to sika Sampulu woy Sagboka no Hibatoon din

Bali pad naan inkatokow on ka sika sampulu no hibatoon din woy sagboka ki Hisus ko ogkokoon sikandan. Pigsawoy ni Hisus sikandan su makogal so ulu ran to wa nigtuu to sika nakakita kandin to nootawan on.
Duon dod insugu ni Hisus kandan. Kagi rin, “Ogmanhipanow kow dio to tibo no mgo ugpaanan kai to soin no kalibutan woy pannangoni now ka tibo no mgo koot-otawan to Maroyow no Nangnangonon.

Sikan otow no ogtuu to soini no Maroyow no Nangnangonon woy ogkabautismuan sikandin, ogkouyag no waro katamanan dio to Magboboot. Di sikan no otow no kono ogtuu, oglogparan sikandin to mohuri no allow.

Ogbogayan ka mgo nigtuu to kabogbogan to oghimu to mgo koin-inuan. Ogpakarogil sikandan to mgo busow no nigsolod to lawa to mgo otow ko oghingaranan dan ka koddi no ngaran. Ka dangob, ogpakakagi to loin no mgo kinagian.
Ko ogpakagongon to ulod no oghilu woy ko ogpokoinum to oghilu kono oghiluon sikandan. Ka dangob pad. Ogsamsamanon dan ka mgo otow no nigdaralu no ogkabawian on ka sikan no mgo otow.”
Nigbatunon si Hisus dio to Langit
Ko si Hisus no Lagboy no Igbuyag ta, ko nakaponga to ogkagi to mgo hibatoon din, nigbatun sikandin dio to langit no nigpinnuu dio to kawanan to Magboboot.

No ka mgo hibatoon din, nanhipanow on no ognangonnangon to Maroyow no Nangnangonon dio to agad hondoi. Ka nigbulig kandan to talabau ran ian ka Lagboy no Igbuyag no nigbogayan din sikandan to kabogbogan to oghimu to mgo igkoinuinu oyow ogkataga ka mgo otow to malogot ka nangnangonon dan. Amin.

footnotes.text: Ko ogsalop on ka allow, nigbunsud ka sunud no allow to mgo Hudiu. Su ian ian, ko salop on ka allow to Allow ran to Oghimoloy, ogkaayun to ogtalabau.
